c:
All o' the snakes are fitting in better than we could possibly have imagined. This brings me so much hope for K'aresh.

Ye've done a great thing here, <name>!
d:
Speaking o' eggs--I checked, an' has laid her clutch. It's almost time to hatch us some babies!

Meet me back at the nest an' we can welcome our first snakelets to K'aresh.
p: What an excitin' time.

c: Great! I'll signal Ve'nari so she can send us one o' her gods-forsaken portals an' we'll be on our way.
d:
Last, but certainly not least, we need to get those two snakes off o' me plane!

I dunno how long snakes normally live, but it seems like those two have been there forever. And they always look at me funny if I come near.

Maybe you could go get 'em?
obj: Gather the two snakes off of the crashed plane at the Nesingwary Safari.
p: You got 'em?

c:
We need to make sure the snakes are as comfortable as possible when we take 'em to K'aresh.

But, yikes. The smell o' those plants. Fragrant indeed!
d:
O' course, we also need some snakes. That's the whole point o' why we came out here in the first place.

You can find the small ones we want down in the Telaari Basin to the south. Just rustle their dens an' they'll come slitherin' out. That's where the plants they like grow.

Speaking of which, make sure to get some o' them fragrant plants while you're at it. Ye might not know this, but snakes have a keen sense o' smell.
obj: Collect 10 Nagrand Snakes and 20 Fragrant :Dreaming Glory.
p: How many do you have? I canna tell. Your pack always looks so full.

c:
Splendid. It was enjoyable to watch both the k'arroc and yourself flying around out there.

You are quite the accomplished rider, <name>.
d: We've been taking the k'arrocs out for flights outside of the Oasis. Perhaps you might be interested in riding one?

c: Good. The rutaani will accept this without complaint. Peace rests on gestures such as these.
d:
This meal is more than tradition, it is a promise.

The Haranir, Rutaani, and Fungarians share no love, but in Har'mara they share this table. To honor that pact, each must be fed in their own way. That is what this meal means.

For the Rutaani, they will need nutrient-rich soil as they draw sustenance through their roots. A few bags of it should do.
p: I hope you bring news of good soil.

c:
I asked for you help without tellin' you about how my mother treated my brother and me. I don't speak much about my family. I learned not to.

I still don't understand why she was the way she was. Maybe somethin' happened to her. Somethin' that'd cause all dat pain... Maybe pain and chaos were all she knew herself.

But in de tribe, she inspired many--at least she can remain a mother to dem.
d:
Iz'ken left us many years ago, <name>. Preparin' may be tense, but at least we won't have to do it alone.

First, we need to collect de spores of de weepin' mushrooms. You can get dem from the mushrooms, or de boars.

I'll be usin' dem to create incense for de ritual.

Be careful, <name>--de boars might be unhappy when we take their food.
obj: Collect 30 Weeping Spores from Weeping Caps or boars in the Solemn Valley.
p:
They're called weepin' spores, because when dey burn dey make your eyes water.

De spores give our warriors a good excuse if dey are too cowardly to admit their feelings at de pyre.

c:
Intriguing. This artifact's potential has been deepened, perhaps by the fraying of this timeline. It can harness more power than any incarnation of it that I have yet encountered.

Let me record that data point for Moratari.

Oh, important reminder--don't forget to recover the bronze simulacrum later or things might get... funky.

And lastly, maybe don't mention to people how you got that. It could ruin the experiment.
d:
Now that you have your infinite bronze, we just need to select the right artifact for you, shape the bronze into a suitable simulacrum of the weapon, and then reach through a temporal knot and swap them.

No one will be the wiser.

All we have to do is remember to reclaim the simulacrum in this timeline and everything will work itself out.

Let's start by selecting your specialization, that'll determine which artifact we'll be borrowing.
obj: Speak to Momentus after choosing a talent specialization
Purchase Remix Time trait in your Artifact Weapon
p: Every artifacts needs a mighty hero to wield it.

c: We could hear ye from here. How many lessons have ye had?
d:
Most o' the snakes did not like Ve'nari's teleport. Others were cloned by Om'talad, an' they don't like that either. They're clearly agitated an' I'm afraid they're gonna hurt themselves.

I've got this flute. Don't ask. I can't even play the darned thing.

Would ye take it out there an' soothe the snakes with some calming melodies?
obj: Use Hemet's Soothin' Flute to soothe 15 Agitated Snakes.
p: I'm certain you're much better at playin' that thing than me.

c:
These look to be in good shape considering how long we left them here.

Not sure if Fiona's even still looking for these, but she'll appreciate the uh... very late gesture.
d:
When Tarenar and I escaped the city before, we left some things behind.

An open bar tab, sure. But we'd also bought souvenirs for some of our friends.

Could you look around for them? They're somewhere in this mess.
obj: Art and Architecture of Silvermoon: Vol. 3
p: Have you found all the souvenirs? We got other things for the rest of our crew back in Suramar, but we didn't have time to mail these when we escaped.

d: :Aid the ongoing battle against the Children of Ula'tek.
t: Temple Patrol: Slay Children of Ula'tek

d: :Aid the ongoing battle against the Children of Ula'tek.

c:
Woah! I thought Rustol was gonna send through a gerbil or a can of peaches or somethin' to test out the new teleporter, not an actual person.

But you're only sizzlin' a little bit! Fantastic.

Tell ya what. For doin' us a solid and havin' such little regard for your own personal safety, we'll let ya use the teleporters free of charge whenever ya want.
d:
Hey, you lookin' to make a few coins?

We made a deal with the earthen to build a teleporter up in Dornogal. We get all the tourism traffic we want, and they get their pick of the finest cracked chipped, or otherwise unsellable gemstones Undermine's jewelers can offer.

I just got this end of things workin', but I haven't tested it out yet. You wanna try? If you come out the other side, my coworker Kenzi will compensate ya.

We'll say this constitutes a verbal waiver, yeah?
obj: Use the teleporter to travel from Undermine to Dornogal.
Use the teleporter to travel to Dornogal

c: Hmm. Not bad. For a novice.
d:
Looks like de boy has realized there is more in dis world than his family farm an' de big bad trolls of Zul'Aman.

But I'm not done with him yet. He gonna learn hard work too. De boy needs to make up for de disruption he caused and de work we lost.

It'll be a learnin' opportunity--for de both of you.

You are goin' to make somethin' for us.

Pay attention. One wrong move can destroy de lightwood. With de Twilight's Blade sabotagin' our equipment, our resources are too limited already.
obj: Follow Woodcrafter Azai's instructions to craft a Lightwood Javelin.
p:
De lightwood is challengin' to work with, even for experienced woodcrafters.

Be patient. Be precise. And do everything I say.

c: The Ascendant Netherhammer! A tool truly worthy of an artisan of my skill. The things I will be able to create... Of course, you will be rewarded for your efforts. Take this Ascendant Voidshard. You will need several more before you can coalesce them into an :Ascendant Voidcore. I will help you transfer its energies into your most powerful equipment at the Voidforge.
Well fought, <name>. But our task is not yet over.
d:
Our elven allies have arrived. It is time to take the fight to the Darkwell.

Xal'atath's forces hold the bridge and recently pushed into the harbor to reinforce their position. We must retake the harbor, launch our naval forces, and use a combined assault to take the bridge.

Are you ready, <name>?
obj: Complete the Battle of the Bridge scenario.
The Battle of the Bridge won

c: My friend! I knew I could count on you. Please take these tokens for your effort.
d:
It's been many months since we arrived in Dornogal and there's still more to learn of Valorstones. It turns out they can be found beyond Azeroth! This discovery opens up entirely new avenues of research.

With new research comes a need for new supplies. Bring me some, and we'll help upgrade your gear to new heights.
obj: Collect 50 Valorstones while adventuring in Khaz Algar, Undermine, and K'aresh, then return to Cuzolth and upgrade a piece of Season 3 equipment.
Upgrade a piece of equipment with Valorstones
p: There's no need to hurry. But if you wouldn't mind hurrying anyway...

c:
It's all a trap. Ula'tek's death will only unleash something worse.

The Twilight's Blade knew this. And we were blind.

I was blind.
d:
I've been able to trace where Antenorian fled. He is more powerful than he was before, after that jaunt through the void space.

Fortunately, this makes him easy to track. He's below us, in an open cavity underground. I can open a portal there.

I hope that we can put an end to this, and Arator is no worse for wear. When we started this, I thought we would find a few scrolls, uncover their plan, and put a stop to it ourselves.

I did not anticipate this.
obj: Enter the tomb and permanently defeat Antenorian.
Use portal to leave Tomb of Mun'jin

c:
What a remarkable story!

How ironic that the tale of Sai'alyo, the first of the Zur'ashar, was lost to time. Your efforts bring us closer to understanding this vital piece of our history.

Please, accept this keepsake as a mark of my gratitude for your dedication.

For now, I will delve deeper into our archives, uncovering relics that still long for discovery.

Return when the whispers of the world guide you back to me.
d:
For untold eons, the Cauldron of Echoes has rested in shadow, its purpose obscured by time.

When I first walked the path of the Zur'ashar, my master spoke of its significance--a relic tied to the very origins of our kind. Yet its secrets eluded even them... a mystery left unanswered.

Now, it calls to us once more.

Will you uncover what has been forgotten? The truth waits within, and I would be forever grateful for your discovery.
obj: Travel to the Glade of Walking Memories in Harandar to learn the history of the Cauldron of Echoes.
Learn about the Echoes of Sai'alyo
p: Has your journey revealed the truth of the Cauldron of Echoes? Share what you have uncovered.

c:
Zul'jan...

Why would you do dis, brother?
d:
Are these tortollans lost? How long have dey been here?

We have a settlement of dem near de Shrine of Filo, but dis is a place dey should not be.

A day not long ago, I would have chased dem off. But we've been havin' good luck with outsiders.

We should talk to dem. Maybe dey know how dis started.
obj: Ask Captain Tokka what he has seen at Tokka's Landing.
p: We need to find out more about dis island if we gonna find our people.

c:
That's what I'm talkin' about!

Now those bots'll be able to work without bein' hassled by all them nasty Black Blood monsters out there.
d:
Even if we got bots out there an' not workers, there are still gonna be monsters out there gettin' in their hair, er, wirin'.

Get out there an' thin out the wildlife. That'll keep our bots from gettin' damaged and voidin' whatever warranty they got left.

The longer they can stay out there, the longer we can stay right here!
obj: Kill enemies in the Writhing Fields in the Ringing Deeps.
Enemies killed in the Writhing Fields (0/100%)
p: Got any good news, kid?

c:
Would you look at Threadis! I know they are very proud of that little bot they built, so I'm glad they were able to bring it to a place where their talents are appreciated.

I'll stay here and see if I can have a chat with Professor Neltik. Why don't you take Kitzy? We'll meet you in Dornogal when you're finished!
obj: Take Threadis to visit the rocket drill to Undermine.
Take Threadis to the Rocket Drill
Ride the Rocket Drill to Undermine with Threadis
Take Threadis and Speak to Security
Take Threadis to the Kaja'Cola Stand in Slam Central Station
Use Threadis's Airship Dog Coupon in Slam Central Station
Discover a new opportunity for Threadis
p:
My, this place is certainly different! It's almost the complete opposite of the Weaver's Lair. Not to mention all the colors... and smells.

It has been fun to watch the goblin children at play, though. They have more in common with the Arathi, kobold, and nerubian children than I would have imagined!

They're certainly a handful...

c:
Cultists? Xal'atath seems intent on undermining us at every turn.

We must be grateful she continues to underestimate your skills.

With the Nightborne ready, that means our forces are gathered. We will position ourselves and strategize how best to deploy our forces.

Thank you, champion.
d:
We have learned much about the forces we will be facing in the battle to come.

Suramar remembers the debt we owe the sin'dorei for their aid in our time of need. Now that our forces are assembled and our golems prepared, we are ready to defend this city as if it were our own.

Come, <name>. Let us return to Lor'themar. It is time to discuss battle strategy.
obj: Return to the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.
t: The Elves are Going to War

c:
You've bought us a moment of peace.

Rest well, but always keep your blade sharp.
d:
These Sureki sure are a persistent bunch! We need to match their persistence with our blades.

Can we count on your continued support in the battles ahead?
p: Ready yourself soldier, the battle is still to come.

c: That was fast, <name>! Faster than I go, these days. I'll leave the speedin' along to you.
d:
Those necrorays responded really well to those treatments you gave 'em! So well in fact that one of 'em is needin' to burn off some energy.

Would ye be able to wear it out?
obj: Challenge the Zooming Necroray to a race and reach the finish line.
p: Have ye worn the thing out yet?

c: The Oasis will benefit greatly from your efforts. My thanks.
d:
Our custodians have yet to do their daily cleanup of the necrorays' discharge. I have many buyers in Tazavesh lined up for this material. They need it urgently, so its collection falls to you.

Take the vacuum device. Compensation will be provided.
obj: Clean 25 Congealed Lumps in the Oasis.
p: Have you succeeded at your task?

c:
Thank you, <name>.

I hope the water is as powerful as my mentor says it is. The strong poison of these creatures suggests I'm going to need it to survive the ritual.
d:
I'd hoped Chua hadn't seen me. Better he thinks I died. Instead, I'm self-exiling.

I was trapped in the Rift of Aln while saving him. Being in there for so long corrupted my connection to the goddess--if I don't sever it soon, it'll drive me mad, or worse.

The Shul'ka who saved me has agreed to mentor me through the process. He told me to come here and gather some things for a ritual to sever the connection.

I must collect the nearby healing waters. Will you help me fill this jug?
p: I appreciate your help, <name>.

c:
The work we have done here can ensure that, with what happened at Eco-Dome: Adani, we can rebuild K'aresh.

It will take time. So very much time. But I suppose that is the advantage of being immortal yes? Even if it takes tens of thousands of years, my home will be rebuilt.

Hopefully, I will be around to see it happen. I have a stasis pod with your name on it, should you have need of it.
d:
It is finished. By all measurements, the eco-system in the Oasis is fully stable. While there will always be things we can help with, it would survive if we left it alone.

Take some time and speak with everyone. Congratulate them. Good work should be properly acknowledged.

Speak with me when you are done.
obj: Talk to your team in the Oasis.

c: This is quite the ensemble you've brought to my lands, <race>.
d:
We must retake the Darkwell and defeat L'ura before the world is torn asunder.

We will need an army. No. Many armies.

We need to reach out to the other elves. We should start with the kaldorei at Bel'ameth. Oculeth can teleport a small envoy there and we can present our request.

Still... there has been much blood spilt among the elves. Vendettas that go far and strike deep. Hold on to hope, <name>. It is all we have left.
obj: Listen to Arator's plan and then use Telemancer Oculeth's Portal to Bel'ameth.

c:
You know... I thought I would be sad if this didn't work, but I actually feel okay!

I still believe. There's so much magic in the world. And even if Aln'sharan isn't exactly what I think he is... his story still exists for a reason. And that's important to me, I think.
d:
This is it! We have all the skyglass we can carry.

The legends say that Aln'sharan cries crystal tears to mourn the missing Goddess. Maybe if we give the crystals back to him, he won't be so sad? Maybe then he'll appear for us!

Meet me back at the village. I think I know the perfect place to make our offering.
p: Come on! We don't wanna miss our chance! Also all of this skyglass is heavy. Can't you carry some?!

c:
What was beyond those doors was a horror. To use the Light in such a manner...

Thank you. We will have this place scoured with flames before it is used again.
d:
We need to get into the Sanctum. Now.

Burn away the roots on that door! And be prepared--nothing good can be behind it.
obj: Open the door to the Sanctum of the Sun and deal with what lies beyond.
p: We cannot wait.

c:
I have not seen de likes of dis since I walked de land of de livin'.

I believe ye found one of de honored Med'jai medallions, possessed by heroic warriors believed to guard dis temple wit' their very souls.
obj: Show the gem to Me'si at the temple hub.

c: A grim task, <name>. But one that may bring a small measure of comfort to those that live.
d:
Our vanguard forces have been harrying the Devouring Host, probing for weaknesses and gathering intelligence.

Unfortunately, nearly all of them have succumbed to the host. We are too late to help those who have fallen, but perhaps we can gather something to remember them by.

Will you do this, <name>? Recover mementos of the fallen so they can be returned to those they fought to protect.
obj: Recover Mementos from fallen Vanguard Scouts.
p: Have you recovered them yet? I'm sure these keepsakes will be a source of comfort to their loved ones.

c: I could hear the angry hissing from here, <name>! Hopefully the Children of Ula'tek will stay away from our fishing spot for a while.
d:
The Children of Ula'tek eat venom-cursed fish straight from the water. Now that we've made the fish stronger, the children have gone into a feeding frenzy!

Captain Tokka says to stop the poaching. The children have plenty of venom already!
obj: Kill 9 Children of Ula'tek in the Serpent's Tail.
p: I can still see the poachers roaming about. Can you get rid of a few more? I don't like how close they are to our camp here!

c: I hope you're prepared to hunt, <name>. This quarry is more elusive than most.
d:
Vicious voidbeasts have been snatching our officers, <name>. I've been told that you saw one from afar, through Umbric's void scryer.

Those beasts are steeped in void energy, using their instinctual mastery of teleportation to strike at our most vulnerable before melting back into the shadows.

Alleria has gone after them, and sent a request for another pair of eyes. You can find her at a campsite at the mouth of the gorge to the east. I'll mark it on your map.

c:
My younger brother left us when I was just comin' of age.

He sent word he would come and help but... we did not part on good terms.

But here he is. After all dis time.
d:
Hash'ura, could I ask for your aid?

My mother passed recently, and I'm de one responsible for performin' her death rituals. It's a lotta work for one person to do.

Most would get help from their family, but I don't have any left. Can you help me?
obj: Meet Chana in the Solemn Valley.

c:
Oh thank the light! I thought I'd be food for sure!

Can you free me from this thing?
d:
These void beasts are elusive, able to open temporary void portals that they can use to move short distances instantaneously.

They may be beneath Turalyon's notice, but they're having devastating effects on the vanguard's morale.

Between the two of us I'm confident we can outmaneuver them.
obj: Track down the void beasts in the gorge.

c: Well done, <name>. Certainly a first.
d:
Today, we create life.

Assuming my calculations are correct--which they are--we can use the essence you gathered along with the data we have collected to create new slatebacks.
obj: Help Ve'nari use her machine to create life in the Oasis.
Insert Ghost Essences into the Oasis Console

c:
<Name>, surely you remember my aunt, Vereesa Windrunner. You were with us at the ruins of Dalaran when her visions of the Void assaulting the Sunwell first manifested.

She and her Silver Covenant, what remains of the quel'dorei as they once were, will prove invaluable in the fight to come.

;Characters who did not complete the Visions of a Shadowed Sun questline:
Champion, this is Vereesa Windrunner. My aunt. She raised me in Silvermoon until she relocated to Dalaran.

She and her Silver Covenant, what remains of the quel'dorei as they once were, will prove invaluable in the fight to come.
d:
<Name>, while the kaldorei are mustering, I could use your help as a witness as I ask another group for aid.

We will need the quel'dorei for what is to come, no matter how much some of the sin'dorei will protest.

Oculeth has agreed to open a portal for the two of us to reach my aunt, Vereesa Windrunner, where she awaits us in Eversong.

The sin'dorei will not come with me. Will you?
obj: Take Oculeth's portal to Eversong Woods.

c:
She agreed?

Alleria listens to you, my champion. You are indeed our savior.
d:
During the Devouring War, I witnessed the horrific results of the All-Devouring's presence. A mortal being cannot approach him at the manaforge. He is the entropy of the end, and you are just flesh.

Xal'atath knows rituals from across the Great Dark Beyond. With the power of the Reshii Ribbons, she was able to transform the K'areshi so they could withstand Dimensius.

Alleria will not like this plan. You must convince her!
obj: Convince Alleria to let Xal'atath perform the ritual of transformation on you.
Stay a while and listen to Alleria (Optional)
p: Every moment spent debating or arguing is a moment closer to Dimensius emerging.

c: Give it a bit, <name>. Can't rush love!
d:
I was out and about checking on these slatebacks of yours, and your broker friends are wrong!

The slatebacks are giving off the smell of love, but it's just not strong enough to overpower all this dry air on K'aresh. Not yet anyway! I whipped up a batch of pheromones that should fix them right up!

Take this sprayer and douse the slatebacks. That'll get things started!
p: Have you got them smellin' better?

c: I have no idea what the First Arcanist is referring to. We have been at peace for some time now.
d:
Champion, your timing is fortuitous. I sent the call for the armies of Suramar to muster, but they have not arrived yet.

My seneschal should have alerted me if anything went wrong, but I have heard nothing.

I plan to go to Suramar to investigate what is amiss. Would you join me? I may have need of your skills.
obj: Use Oculeth's portal to travel to Suramar.

c: How did it feel to be the first person to fly on the back of a k'arroc in a millennia?
d:
The shielding device you helped with has been tested. It is ready for its first flight, if you will forgive the turn of phrase.

Speak with Om'torid. They have a course picked out for you and the k'arroc to soar along.
obj: Test out the shield device by taking a k'arroc for a flight outside of the Oasis.
p: How did the shield hold up?

c: There we go! Just what I was lookin' for. Hope that wasn't too hard for ya!
d: You're a shrewd negotiator, <name>. That's good fun! I'll start packing. You go get some bug bits for me, okay?
obj: Collect 50 Bug Bits in Rak-ush and the nearby area.
Chop a Large Bug Bit into Bug Bits (Optional)
p: How'd it go?

c: Make ready, <name>. Soon, we will pay Xal'atath back for all she has done to us.
d:
I know better than to question my wife when she's set on a target, but I trust that the target was chosen well.

Our forces have acquitted themselves admirably, readying the battlefield for the main assault. Now listen, as the war council begins.

c: Thank you, <name>. I had wished for better, but it helps to know their fates in dis world.
d:
I am not de only Med'jai tasked with keeping sentinel over de priests. There were three of us, entombed in stone that matched how we looked in life.

I must know if dey are still there. Can you help me find them? My body is bound in dis stone, but my spirit is not. Bring my gem to those places, if you can find dem.

If we cannot wake dem, we will at least honor dem.
obj: Find the resting place of Thaze'ala's fellow guardians.
p: Have you found dem, <name>? My brothers and sisters.

c:
Netherdeath is no more. Our exploration of Untethered Space can proceed. I knew you were the right person to help us in our endeavors, <name>.

We would be honored if you would continue to work with us in our exploration.
d:
Void predators that have recently invaded Untethered Space are a mere annoyance compared to the ancient creatures that traveled here long ago. These primal predators feed on the energies of the remnants of old K'aresh, as well as the unfortunate K'areshi who have fallen into this state of being.

There is one such creature we call Netherdeath that haunts this rock. We have only been able to drive it away. Perhaps you have the skill to end its reign of terror?
p: Have you rid Untethered Space of this predator?

c: You learn quickly. Good. Untethered Space devours the foolish and unwise.
d:
The Reshii Wraps that the Harbinger gave you allow you to briefly transform into energy and fall into Untethered Space. This is a nightmare for all ethereals--a natural result of losing our wraps and radiating away our energy.

We can control the process by properly attuning with the Phase Conduit, letting us visit this sub-realm and return intact. That is the theory. We have tested it with K'areshi Phase Divers, but not with one of your kind.

Are you willing to risk the journey to Untethered Space?
obj: Interact with the Phase Conduit while wearing the Reshii Wraps.
p: Untethered Space is beautiful to visit, but dangerous for those that are trapped there.

c: We're nearly prepared. Although I can't help but wonder if Adarus' reach exceeds his grasp.
d:
At last, <name>. With the promise of this fragment's power, and my mastery over the illidari ways, I will be ready to fight the shadowguard and any other threats the void throws at us.

Leona spoke of a cave near Shan'dorah where the void energies suffusing K'aresh converge.

Meet us there, and play a part in my ascension.
obj: Meet Adarus and Leona at the ritual site inside the cave at the Fracture of Laacuna.

c: You've been helpful so far. And in return, I'll allow you to take part in making history on this discarded, broken corpse of a planet.
d:
The Void espouses all truths, <name>. And in none of them do I defeat Ramon'ta without some help.

And here you are.

My quarry is a cosmic worm known as Ramon'ta the Insatiable. It started out small enough, but with each void entity it feasts upon, it grows, and its power grows along with it.

If we can defeat it, I can claim its power. Will you help me?
obj: Help Leona defeat the empowered cosmic worm and claim its power.
Report back to Adarus in Shan'dorah
p: Wrap this up quickly, <class>. I have more important matters to attend to.

c:
The haranir seek to join the fight against the Void?

Far be it from me to look a gift hawkstrider in the mouth. Halduron has vouched for both their strength and their tenacity. We shall need a great deal of both, in the battles to come.
d:
Your actions in Harandar caused quite an uproar. The elders are up in arms. The rootwardens are worried. It's really quite exhausting.

But there is good news as well. Orweyna has heard rumblings from every corner of the roots. She tells me of haranir who wish to see the world as she does--who feel compelled to seek the goddess beyond the boughs of Harandar.

I will handle things in Harandar. Go to your leaders. Tell them that the haranir are ready to join the fight.
obj: Bring word to Lor'themar in the Sanctum of Light.

c:
My, look at Destien!

I don't think he's ever talked so much before. The nerubians must have left a strong positive impression on him indeed.

I can't wait to hear what he's learned by spending some time with you today. Who knows? Perhaps this is a small start to a better understanding between the two races.

Oh! The nerubian youngling, Threadis, has been eagerly awaiting you. They don't speak yet, which is common for young nerubians, but they can still communicate using other methods.
d:
H-hello! I'm Destien. Eathen Matron Ullna told me about you, and said you are an adventurer! You must have seen all kinds of spooky and awesome things, right?

T-there is one thing I would like to do, but I'm worried it will scare people.

I've heard there are good nerubians and that you've met them! I've always wanted to talk to one but they scare me.

Would you come with me to meet them?
obj: Take Destien to the Weaver's Lair to meet the Widow.
Take Destien to the Weaver's Lair
Take Destien to Meet the Silksingers
Take Destien to Meet An Ascended
Take Destien and Return to Widow Arak'nai
p: My goodness! The nerubians certainly have an interesting society. The younglings seem to be very different than the Arathi children, even though they're similar in their desire to play and get into trouble.

c:
Good.

For far too long we have been beset by threats. Striking back will send a message.
d:
I don't like it.

We have far too many scouts returning wounded from these so-called ritual sites.

Thin out the ranks of these cultists.
obj: Defeat enemies in a Ritual Site.
Defeat Enemies in the Ritual Site
p: Is the job done?

c:
Did the renovation go well? I hope it gives you a little more room for all the treasures you find in your adventures.

Be sure to visit the general contractor again when you're next ready for an upgrade.

Oh, and a letter arrived for you while you were away.
d:
It looks like your house is ready for an upgrade. This doesn't normally happen so fast, but you've really made an impression around here.

Head on over to our general contractor for next steps.
p: Did you get your house upgraded?

c:
These threads contain traces of potential epoch energy. To access their power we'll need to infuse them into a stabilizing material, such as infinite bronze, in order to anchor them in place.

They'll lose some of their potency, but at least they will be sufficient for our needs.
d:
To get you an artifact we'll need some temporal energy.

Normally we use infinite cloaks woven from temporal threads, but those threads are frayed in this timeline. So instead I need you to gather those frayed temporal threads from around Dalaran.

You can find them popping into and out of existence here and there. They look like radiant golden orbs of power, you can't miss them.

Once you have enough of them bring them back to me.
obj: Collect Frayed Temporal Threads from the streets of Dalaran.
p: With this source of power Momentus should have what he needs to help you get an artifact.

c: A fine collection of epoch objects.
d:
If we're going to help Khadgar, Dalaran, and our experiment, we're going to need to get you an artifact.

Luckily I have a plan to accomplish just this.

Dalaran is currently loaded with all manner of temporally important items--so called epoch objects. We'll gather up a few that won't be missed, blame their disappearance on the Legion, and then use them to get you that artifact.

Here, I've made a shopping list.
obj: Recover the Dusty Stone Tablet, Bent and Battered Blade, and the Curious Curio for Momentus.
p: These objects are loaded with epoch significance.

c: Good work! Full bellies ought to keep 'em happy enough.
d:
The local ottuks have a symbiotic relationship with the tuskarr, and it's feeding time.

Can ye put out some of the meat ye gathered for them?
obj: Place a Pile of Meat for the local ottuks just outside Iskaara.
p: Have ye fed those ottuks yet?

c: Chase that paper!
Chase that paper!
Chase that paper!
You may call upon this aid for any vision.
d:
Hello, Champion.

I have found a way that I may further assist you in the visions. Should you require it, you can call upon my assistance using this hourglass.

I will form a construct that will assist you in the vision.
obj: Interact with the hourglass and gain Soridormi's assistance.
p: I hope you find this useful.

c:
I'm glad I went through with this. Thanks for coming with me.

Let's get back to the others in the Voidstorm, <name>.
d:
There is one unresolved matter...

Hieron wanted her to have it. She should know what happened to him.

This is on me. Silvermoon again... Guess I'll see you when I'm back, <name>.
obj: Speak to Umbric about meeting with Astre in Silvermoon City.
p: At least I'm not visiting my parents.

d:
;Founder's Point
Welcome, neighbor! I've got just the thing for you here. These dyes I have here will let you give the decor you buy from our local decor vendors an extra pop of color. Take these and try them out, no charge. Be careful, though. Each only works once.

And if you want more, alchemists and scribes can grind up herbs to create pigments, when use those pigments at this dye station to create more dyes. You can also probably find them on the Auction House, if you're not interested in making your own.

;Razorwind Shores
I have something for you, neighbor. Just between you and me, these decor vendors don't always have the greatest palette sensibilities. I hope yours are better. If you're going to put those... things in your house? Try recoloring them with these dyes. Each dye can be used just once, so make sure you like what you're doing before you apply them.

But if you want more, any scribe or alchemist can grind up herbs to create pigments, then use those pigments at this station to make more dyes.

c: Hope you like getting your hands dirty.
d:
Ranger Valsarin is a chef at Farstrider Hold. He's decent in a kitchen, but his passion is field cooking.

There was a time when you could wander any path in Eversong and find the ingredients for a good meal. A Farstrider's dream! With enough hard work, we can help the forest recover, and it starts with rehabilitating the soil.

Meet Valsarin at the North Tower and he can tell you more.
obj: Meet Ranger Valsarin at the North Tower.

c: Well done. I have transferred the necrorays to the Atrium as per our quarantine procedures.
d:
I suppose you will be heading back now?

It has been a true joy to work with you, apprentice. I hope we will see each other soon. I'll have some new experiments for you to help me out with. Please do take care of the necrorays! I hope they enjoy their new home.
obj: Travel to the Oasis on K'aresh.

c:
I don't know what this fake bear is planning.

But it's better that his lodestones are destroyed.
d:
This big bear called himself the Voice of Nalorakk and has "chosen" some of our tribe as his favorites. He doesn't know, but I saw him put dark, glowing lodestones in the totems around the village to give his chosen power.

Dark power radiates from them. The power smells wrong. Not like Nalorakk.

Our guardian bears get agitated and upset near them. They can smell it too!

We must cleanse the camp. Get rid of those totems!
obj: Destroy 4 corrupted totems in Spiritpaw Village.

c: Good, you found me. Now the hunt can begin.
d:
Good news! We have a lead. Rexxar has agreed to help us find Scrapes. If anyone can track down that undead murderer, it's him.

Rexxar has followed the scent to the Borean Tundra. He left this note for you.
obj: Follow the note's coordinates to Rexxar's location in the Borean Tundra.
Rexxar found in the Borean Tundra
Speak to Rexxar in the Borean Tundra.

c: I must say, I underestimated you. It seems there's more to you than just flailing around.
d:
Hah! You actually managed to defeat the spell books? I suppose even a blind squirrel finds a nut once in a while.

Don't get too proud of yourself though! My followers ahead won't be so easily dismantled by your flailing. When you inevitably fail, I'll be sure to remember this as the moment your arrogance got the better of you.
p: Ah! So you've come crawling back after failing to defeat even my least competent followers?

c: Renzi's really been rackin' up the recruits lately. You're gonna have some competition!
d:
Ey! I heard you've been cleanin' up some of the trash around Undermine. Good on ya.

Any interest in takin' that more literally?

It's a dirty job, but lots of gold to be made if you're good at it. If that sounds up your alley, go talk to the boss man Carlo back at Undermine Sanitation.

Tell him I sent ya so I get my recruitment bonus!
obj: Talk to Carlo Greasegrind at Undermine Sanitation.

c: No no, I've got it! Stand back!
d:
In hindsight, we should have gone drinking in neutral territory.

Gidwin and I were here in Silvermoon on vacation when the Fourth War broke out. We escaped the city but left behind a... rather large bar tab.

Gidwin's run off to the place we were staying to find an expensive item we'd left behind, but he's late. Would you go find him while I keep this debt collector busy? He should have been back by now.

c: Good work tagging those necrorays. We'll be able tae keep a better eye on them this way.
d:
Tag the necrorays with these darts. It'll monitor their location and health. It also injects a pain killer so the necrorays don't even notice it.

These brokers have some incredible inventions!
p: Have ye tagged those rays?

c:
The camera doesn't lie, <name>.

You are one stylish <class>.
d:
The Trial of Style gives us the opportunity to look good, <class>.

The camera makes sure we keep looking good.

So focus on me and my camera, follow my directions and I'll make sure you look fantastic!
obj: Focus on the photographer and follow their directions.
p:
Focus on me and follow my directions.

I'll make sure you look great.

c: There are fewer shadows in the world thanks to your efforts.
d: These lands house many deep crevices, leaving shadows where our enemies believe they are safe. Explore these hidden places and leave our enemies no sanctuary.
obj: Complete a War Within Delve at any difficulty.
Complete a War Within Delve on any difficulty
p: How goes your dangerous exploration?

c: Thank you for bringing all people of Khaz Algar a glimmer of hope.
d:
The enemies of Khaz Algar rise up, unified in the suffering they inflict on those who do not believe in their causes.

Show these people the light, <name>. If they cannot see the error of their ways, please show them a merciful conclusion to their beliefs.
obj: Complete any Seasonal Dungeon at Normal difficulty or higher.
p: How goes the mission?

c: I am glad you made it back safe. I know if we keep looking we will find a key to ending the void's corruption.
d:
This Black Blood that has corrupted the nerubians is nasty stough.

I hear that it is not the first time that the Old Gods have used this blood.

A new visitor to Dorgogal, Soridormi of the Bronze Dragons, has found a way for you to revisit this past event.

Seek her out to relive these Horrific Visions and learn what you can.

Keep your eyes open <name>. Any info you can learn will surely aid us today.
obj: Defeat 5 bosses inside Horrific Visions Revisited.
p: What was it like? I hear you went back and entered someone's nightmare?

c:
When Beledar darkened, what would they have built if they were in our place?

Your efforts continue to be of great service.
d:
Undermine is held together by an intricate design of innovation, hard work, allegiance, and it seems like the sheer will of the goblins. Rather than cower in their sunless cave, the goblins have built a city that thrives on motion and activity. We can learn much from that.

After not seeing new faces for years, they bring a new light to our lands. Go help them in whatever ways seem fitting.
obj: Get kicked out of The Gallagio
p: They don't stop moving just because something doesn't work. I admire that.

c: You made some extraordinary efforts on some... unique requests. Your service to Undermine is appreciated by all.
d:
Undermine may be a place I do not understand, but they too are in need of aid. Our conflicts inflame their situation, it would do good to help them move forward.

Go there and help them. See what you can do to bring these... cartels closer together, and to us.
p: Undermine is very strange to me. Still, when a friend asks for help... you help them.

c: How did you fare? Any new scars? Or new tales to tell?
d:
Hallowfall is not the only land beset by enemies.

Great monsters threaten our allies. Wherever the shadows of our war have fallen, savage beasts and cunning fiends rise up. They murder Arathi, earthen, and the others who stand with us. Innocent farmers to great warriors.

I know the Sacred Flame burns in you. You are our best hope to hunt these great evils.
obj: Defeat all available World Bosses in The War Within.
p: I've seen monsters shifting in the distant darkness of Hallowfall. Things that haunt my nightmares.

c: Dis is good. Their cursed souls will only know oblivion.
d:
De Soulcoilers must pay, <name>.

De Soulcoilers believed their actions saved de Amani. Instead, our people and our future was plundered. We did not realize until it was too late.

End them. Shatter their very souls so that even de great Mueh'zala cannot put dem back together.
obj: Annihilate the essences of the Soulcoilers.
p: Defeat is not enough, <name>. Annihilate their very souls.

c: Thank you, <name>. Your adventures in Untethered Space will help clear the way for our Phase Divers to recover the energy that would have been lost to the Void.
d:
Shad'anis has told me about you--a fleshling with the ability to travel to Untethered Space. How do you accomplish such a feat? Wait--let me deduce.

It must be those wraps you wear as a cloak. They have been modified by a Reshii Ribbon. I have not seen such a thing since the Devouring War. Very nice. Classic.

Do you want classic? Or do you want powerful? I can enhance your Reshii Wraps with modern technomancy techniques to better face the dangers of Untethered Space.
obj: Talk to Hashim about your Reshii Wraps.
Ask Hashim about empowering the Reshii Wraps
p: Enhancing the Reshii Wraps is paramount to your survival.

c: These will do excellent! Ssak'mozek lurks beneath the water. The smell from these leech legs will help draw it to you.
d:
Captain Tokka wants us to fish for Ssak'mozek.

The Children of Ula'tek raise a hydra more vicious and venom-cursed than all the rest. We've caught and killed it before, but they always raise another and give it the same name: Ssak'mozek.

We're going to craft one of Tokka's best lures to draw it in.

Start by collecting the legs of leeches. When broken, they have a smell the children and their creations cannot resist.
obj: Collect 36 Pungent Leech Legs in the Serpent's Tail.
p: Don't break the leech legs, if you can. We need to break them right before we make the lure so the smell is fresh.

c: You <name>? Got something for you.
d: You <name>? Got something for you.

c: I'm glad ye made it back here in one piece, and none too soon. Me an ol' Fitz have been holding off these crazed talbuk attacks for what seems like ages.
d:
Next up, we'll be needin' some moss for their beds. Sorry to say, but we need to go into the slimy marsh for 'em.

The naga control that place. It grows on their mushroom trees. They're also fond o' munching on it or something foul.

Fastest way to Zangarmarsh is through the pass to the north. If it were me, I'd look around the Darkcrest Shore.
p: How much you got? It's one o' the last things we need before we head back to K'aresh.

c: We've cut out the corruption here. In time, the land'll recover.
d:
These gnolls have been corrupting the land--growing too big and throwing off the ecosystem.

We need to stop them, and let this land recover from all that decay.
obj: Slay gnolls and their minions in and around the Brakenhide Hollow.
p: I don't relish the kills, but it has to be done.
